SmartServe brings a practical, prevention-first approach to pest management for homes, businesses and facilities in Alberta communities.

Our process

Inspect. Assess. Control. Monitor. Prevent.

A practical approach that focuses on solving the current issue while reducing conditions that allow pests to return.

01

Inspect

Identify pest activity, entry points and contributing conditions.

02

Assess

Determine the right treatment and prevention strategy.

03

Control

Apply appropriate pest management methods.

04

Monitor

Track activity and document service findings.

05

Prevent

Recommend corrective actions and exclusion measures.

Prevention first

Pest Prevention & Exclusion

We don't just treat pest activity. We help identify conditions that allow pests to return.

  • Door gaps
  • Wall penetrations
  • Pipe openings
  • Cracks and gaps
  • Food and waste sources
  • Exterior harborage areas
Reporting

What service reports can include

  • Inspection findings
  • Pest activity
  • Areas inspected
  • Treatments performed
  • Pest devices monitored
  • Corrective actions
  • Recommendations
  • Follow-up requirements
  • Service date and technician information
